map.name: Vell
map.trouble: Grulga the Swamp Witch and her Trolls hold the Sunken Keep and raid Vell for captives and plunder.

guard_bark.specifics: Torvic of the Marsh Guard keeps the causeway gate of Vell.

first.speaker: Torvic
first.text: Lookin' to spend a night in the stocks?

later.speaker: Torvic
later.text: Fair work with the Trolls. But that doesn't make you a hero! Now move along!

bounty_offer.specifics: The Trolls broke into Hesper's hut and her pet turtle Mortimer is shut in the back room with them.

offer.speaker: Hesper
offer.text:
Oh, please help me, stranger! The Trolls have broken into my hut and my poor turtle, Mortimer, is stuck in the back room with them!

Save him and I'll be grateful to you for the rest of my days!

reminder.speaker: Hesper
reminder.text: Whatever you find in there is yours to keep! Only hurry and save Mortimer!

completion.speaker: Hesper
completion.text:
Oh, thank heavens, he's alive! However can I thank you for your courage?!

Eh? What's that? Heaps and heaps of gold? Well... if gold is what you want, then please accept this as a token of my gratitude.

journal.text: Rescue Mortimer the Talking Turtle from Hesper's hut in Vell.

heirloom_fetch.specifics: Oswig the Sage lost the Staff of Binding to Grulga's Trolls, who took it to the Troll caves.

offer.speaker: Oswig
offer.text: Greetings, Wanderer! Thank goodness you've come at last, for we sorely need your help. Grulga's Trolls swept through Vell only days ago and carried off the Staff of Binding! Will you go to the Troll caves to the southwest and bring the precious Staff back to me as quickly as you can?

refusal.speaker: Oswig
refusal.text: No?! Then I fear Vell is doomed! Please reconsider.

reminder.speaker: Oswig
reminder.text: Make haste and recover the Staff! Go quickly, please! For if she keeps it, Grulga will turn the Staff to the foulest of ends, for certain!

completion.speaker: Oswig
completion.text:
Well done, brave Wanderer! My deepest thanks for bringing back the Staff! Now that we have it again, we can at last put an end to that wicked witch's schemes for good!

Here, these blue potions and this spell book should prove useful... more useful than you know.

after.speaker: Oswig
after.text: My thanks once more, Wanderer, for everything you've done.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Retrieve the Staff of Binding.

rumour.specifics: Fisk, Brena and Tansy, folk of Vell.

rumour1.speaker: Fisk
rumour1.text: Hurry! Mayor Pellig is expecting you in his house across the village. There's a little boat behind the inn that can carry you over to him.

rumour2.speaker: Brena
rumour2.text: Welcome to Vell. Bodo's inn is just there on your left.

rumour3.speaker: Tansy
rumour3.text: Good work saving Mortimer, stranger! I hear Hesper is telling everyone about it!

shop_greeting.specifics: Bodo keeps the inn, Kessik the forge, Ystra the potion and spell shop.

inn.speaker: Bodo
inn.text: You've no business back here. Best get out of my kitchen.

arms.speaker: Kessik
arms.text: Sorry, stranger, the Marsh Guard bought up the lot! I haven't a single shield left to sell you.

magic.speaker: Ystra
magic.text: Hello, stranger. You know Grulga's Trolls have been asking after you.

two_givers.specifics: Vasko sells a used sword for Mayor Pellig's Trial of Blades, and Pellig sends entrants to Kessik's forge.

offer_a.speaker: Vasko
offer_a.text:
Now this sword is a real beauty. Its last owner was a little old granny who only used it to slice cheese.

At Kessik's forge a blade like this would cost you 250 gold, easy. But I like the look of you, so I'll part with it for 90. Well, do you want it?

offer_b.speaker: Pellig
offer_b.text: You'll need a sword of your own for the Trial of Blades. Kessik sells them at an honest price.

outcome_a.speaker: Vasko
outcome_a.text: Here ya go! That sword was meant for your hand. Nobody could lose the Trial holding a blade like that.

outcome_b.speaker: Vasko
outcome_b.text: Big mistake, friend. Go on over to Kessik's and look at his swords. Then hurry on back -- there's another fellow asking after this one too.

journal_a.text: Buy a sword for the Trial of Blades.

journal_b.text: Buy a sword at Kessik's forge for the Trial of Blades.

rescue.specifics: Ulmar begs the player to free Dagny and the boatmen of Vell from the Trolls in the Sunken Keep.

plea.speaker: Ulmar
plea.text: Quickly, lad! The boatmen haven't got long. You've got to free every last one of them before the Trolls cook them!

reminder.speaker: Ulmar
reminder.text: There's no time to lose. Get moving!

completion.speaker: Ulmar
completion.text:
Good work, lad! Every one of these brave boatmen owes you his life!

Take these potions with you. Now go and find the rest of them!

journal.text: Rescue Dagny and the boatmen of Vell held captive in the Sunken Keep.

main_opening.specifics: Ulmar brings the player to Vell and sends him to Mayor Pellig and on against Grulga's Sunken Keep.

herald.speaker: Tansy
herald.text: My, my! You're a lot nicer to look at than the usual fellows Ulmar drags in! Come and see me once Mayor Pellig is done with you.

opening.speaker: Ulmar
opening.text:
Here we are, lad. Vell -- last stronghold of the free folk of the Black Fen! Home of the stout-hearted Marsh Guard!

Get yourself into Vell, find Mayor Pellig and then be ready for the fight of your life -- Grulga's Sunken Keep. Only the bravest come back out.

journal.text: Find a way into the Village of Vell.
